title: Anthology 4 – facts, recording info and more!
content:
The Beatles’ albums in order – complete list! » Anthology 4

Recorded: 1963-1969; 1979; 1995; 2022; 2023
Producers: George Martin, John Lennon, Paul McCartney, George Harrison, Ringo Starr, Jeff Lynne, Giles Martin

Released: 21 November 2025

Tracklisting

‘I Saw Her Standing There’ (take 2 – 11 February 1963)
‘Money (That’s What I Want)’ (RM7 undubbed – 18 July 1963)
‘This Boy’ (takes 12 & 13 – 17 October 1963)
‘Tell Me Why’ (takes 4 & 5 – 27 February 1964)
‘If I Fell’ (take 11 – 27 February 1964)
‘Matchbox’ (take 1 – 1 June 1964)
‘Every Little Thing’ (takes 6 & 7 – 30 September 1964)
‘I Need You’ (take 1 – 15 February 1965)
‘I’ve Just Seen A Face’ (take 3 – 14 June 1965)
‘In My Life’ (take 1 – 18 October 1965)
‘Nowhere Man’ (first version, take 2 – 21 October 1965)
‘Got To Get You Into My Life’ (second version, unnumbered mix – 8 April 1966)
‘Love You To’ (take 7 – 11 April 1966)
‘Strawberry Fields Forever’ (take 26 – 15 December 1966)
‘She’s Leaving Home’ (take 1, instrumental – 17 March 1967)
‘Baby, You’re A Rich Man’ (takes 11 & 12 – 11 May 1967)
‘All You Need Is Love’ (BBC broadcast rehearsal – 23/24 June 1967)
‘The Fool On The Hill’ (Take 5, instrumental – 26 September 1967)
‘I Am The Walrus’ (take 19, strings, brass, clarinet overdub – 27 September 1967)
‘Hey Bulldog’ (take 4, instrumental – 11 February 1968)
‘Good Night’ (take 10 with guitar part from take 5 – 28 June; 22 July 1968)
‘While My Guitar Gently Weeps’ (take 27 – 5 September 1968)
‘(You’re So Square) Baby I Don’t Care’ (9 September 1968)
‘Helter Skelter’ (take 17 – 9 September 1968)
‘I Will’ (Take 29, 16 September 1968)
‘Can You Take Me Back?’ (take 1 – 16 September 1968)
‘Julia’ (two rehearsals – 13 October 1968)
‘Get Back’ (take 8 – 27 January 1969)
‘Octopus’s Garden’ (rehearsal – 26 January 1969)
‘Don’t Let Me Down’ (first rooftop performance – 30 January 1969)
‘You Never Give Me Your Money’ (take 36 – 6 May 1969)
‘Here Comes The Sun’ (take 9 – 7 July 1969)
‘Something’ (take 39 strings only – 15 August 1969)
‘Free As A Bird’ (2025 mix)
‘Real Love’ (2025 mix)
‘Now And Then’

Released in November 2025, Anthology 4 is the fourth instalment of The Beatles’ collection of outtakes, rarities and live performances, released to accompany the 30th anniversary reissue of the TV series The Beatles Anthology.

The album contained 13 previously-unreleased recordings – versions of ‘Tell Me Why’, ‘If I Fell’, ‘Matchbox’, ‘Every Little Thing’, ‘I Need You’, ‘I’ve Just Seen A Face’, ‘In My Life’, ‘Nowhere Man’, ‘Baby, You’re A Rich Man’, ‘All You Need Is Love’, ‘The Fool On The Hill’, ‘I Am The Walrus’, and ‘Hey Bulldog’. There were also remixes of the 1990s reunion songs ‘Free As A Bird’ and ‘Real Love’, and liner notes by Kevin Howlett.

Cover artwork

Klaus Voormann, who had previously designed the cover art for Revolver, was contacted in the early 1990s by Apple Records’ Neil Aspinall to create the artwork for the entire Anthology project.

Voormann came up with an idea to paint The Beatles’ posters, photographs and album artwork with the effect of peeling layers, in a broad chronological order from left to right, charting the progression and development of The Beatles. Anthology 4 features the entire artwork.

The release

Anthology 4 was announced on 20 August 2025, three months ahead of its 21 November release.

It was issued on double CD and triple vinyl sets, as part of the Anthology Collection box sets that include the other Anthology albums.

Published: 21 August 2025 | Last updated: 24 November 2025
